motto: Permanence of record. Permanence of administration.
accessIntro: The Commission maintains records of reported incidents, subsequent reviews, and actions entered against them.
accessBody: Correspondents may consult released records without an appointment. The presence of a record confirms its receipt. It does not confirm the events described.
accessAlter: Correspondents may consult released records without an appointment. The presence of a record confirms your receipt. It does not confirm the events described.
enterNote: No credentials required for public inspection.
firstVisit: First consultation? Open Archive at the workstation to browse records, or Search to find a title or reference number. Begin with an incident, then consult the records filed against it. Returning correspondents begin where they left off. There is no record of where anyone left off.
noticeBody: If a record names you in error, retain the reference number. Do not submit a second name.
noticeAlter: If a record names you, forget the reference number. Do not submit a second name.
noticePostscript: A second name is recorded as a first name.
submissionsBody: File an account of an incident, a discovery report, or a subsequent exploration. Separate what was observed from what was supplied by another correspondent.
submissionsStepOne: Consult existing records. Cite the incident reference where one exists.
submissionsStepTwo: Record the location, sequence of events, and source of each observation. Preserve contradictory accounts as separate records.
submissionsStepThree: Open the record editor at the workstation to prepare a draft. Retain author credit and the lineage of any record you extend.
submissionsStepFour: If a draft closes before it is complete, it is not recoverable. Do not attempt to recover it.
submissionsNotice: Transmission notice: Drafts remain in this browser only while the editor is open. Retain a separate copy before closing or reloading. Saving, publication, and remote filing are not connected.
submissionsDisclosure: Read the rules for submitted material · SP–02
submissionsRuleOne: Submit original material or material you have permission to use. Preserve citations and author credit. Do not include personal details, threats, or targeted harassment of real persons.
submissionsRuleTwo: Disagreement between accounts may be filed. Misconduct toward a correspondent may not. Records removed from public discovery are retained as tombstones under the applicable review procedure.
organizationsBody: To identify an organization, prepare the following particulars. An organization is an entry in the directory; it is not a personnel account.
particularsBriefText: Name, remit, and terms used to classify incidents.
particularsVoiceText: A short sample record in the organization’s own language.
particularsSeedText: An initial incident establishing the basis for a file.
organizationsReview: Review considers interest and coherence. Advisory votes do not confer recognition. Recognition by an existing body requires a separate record and approval from both parties.
organizationsNotice: Organization submissions are not being transmitted from this terminal. Existing dossiers may be consulted through Organizations at the workstation.
credentialsBody: Returning correspondents may sign in with their username or email and password. New correspondents may register a personal account. Public inspection remains open without credentials.
credentialsSmall: A previous appointment does not imply a present vacancy.
aboutBody: The Commission receives incident reports, preserves their supporting records, and maintains the register of organizations, characters, and recoveries. Its jurisdiction is limited to the material on file.
aboutDoctrine: The archive does not decide truth. It decides what is on file.
aboutAddendum: The Commission has been asked to decide once. It declined.
aboutSmall: Authority: continuing administrative arrangement, date of commencement not transferred.
closedIntro: Four pages are listed. None of them is held in this copy.
closedPlanBody: Withdrawn on 08.06.2001. The room remains in use.
closedGuestBody: Closed to entries in 1998. Entries are not returned to correspondents.
closedCircularBody: Superseded. The superseding circular is this circular.
closedPersonnelBody: Reference only. The index lists no names.
closedFootnote: This site is not a member of any ring.
closedDialogHeading: Page not held in this copy
hoursNote: Correspondence received outside these hours will be dated the preceding working day.
hoursAddendum: Enquiries received during opening hours are dated as they arrive.
hoursAddendumAlter: Enquiries already received are dated when they next arrive.
clearanceNote: Classification describes the record, not the correspondent.
newsOneBody: The previous circular remains in force until this revision has been withdrawn.
newsTwoBody: Room 014 has been removed from the floor plan. Correspondence should continue to be addressed there.
newsThreeBody: No interruption to the previous year is anticipated.
newsEnd: No further notices have been received.
newsRefreshed: No notices were received this time. The notices listed previously have been returned to the file.
attendanceNote: Recorded for the duration of the visit.
boardOne: Room 014: the door plate has been removed for repair. The room is in use.
boardTwo: The lift is not in service. It has not been in service since the change of calendar.
boardThree: Correspondence should be collected in person. There is no delivery at present.
withdrawnBody: AC–09 is listed for completeness. No public copy is held. The instruction to remove this reference was filed under AC–09.
imageNotHeldCaption: Plan of the reading room. Image not held.
contactsWriteBody: This terminal has no outgoing correspondence. The address has not changed.
contactsNote: Routing references only. Direct correspondence is not available from this terminal.
revisionFourAmendment: This page corrected. No correction was required.
revisionNote: Entries reproduced as received. Numbering discrepancies are retained.
policyAccessibilityBody: This index supports keyboard navigation, text enlargement, and reduced motion. All public instructions are supplied as text. Reading order takes precedence over the order in which material was received.
policyPrivacyBody: Personal access uses essential session cookies. Account details are held by the Registry; no visit tracking is used. Workstation drafts remain temporary and are not transmitted. Retain a separate copy.
policyTermsBody: Released records may contain incomplete, contradictory, or withdrawn accounts. A reference is evidence of filing, not verification. Retain attribution when extending a record. The Commission assumes no authority over events not yet entered.
